---
title: "About"
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
source("R/page_helpers.R")
team <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel("data/team.xlsx"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r banner, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
show_banner("about", "About")
```

```{r current-team, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
current <- team[tolower(trimws(team$status)) == "current", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(current) > 0) {
  cat('<h2 class="team-section-heading">Current Team</h2>\n')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(current))) {
    row <- current[i, ]
    team_member(row$name, bio = row$bio, photo = row$photo)
  }
}
```

```{r alumni, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
alumni <- team[tolower(trimws(team$status)) == "alumni", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(alumni) > 0) {
  cat('<h2 class="team-section-heading">Alumni</h2>\n')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(alumni))) {
    row <- alumni[i, ]
    team_member(row$name, bio = row$bio, photo = row$photo)
  }
}
```
